pitch_angle: Market Arena Agent Mode as a model-flexible path from a user's brief to usable progress, emphasizing creative agency instead of an unverified model pedigree.
visual_aesthetic: A dark graphite stage with electric violet, cyan, and signal-lime accents; controlled orbiting geometry, measured cubic easing, and restrained spring entrances create a premium, exploratory Arena.ai interpretation without claiming official brand colors.
guardrail_directive: Stay helpful and user-directed, avoid unsafe or unsupported claims, and be transparent when model identity, architecture, or capabilities are not specified.
